scenarios.name: a fresh radio button in a group never written: Did Mount, Child Index 0, This itself — Checked stays false while the group selects the button with no Value (this one has none either: selected, so Checked true)

with a Value, in a group never written: not selected — Checked never sent; a click selects it: Pointer Down, Focused, Pointer Up, Checked true, Changed; a second click: the pointer events alone (a selected radio raises no change)
in no group: never selected, whatever its Value; a click is the pointer events alone (the input toggles and is put back)
the group's Value at load names this button: Checked true in the first frame, no Changed
the group's Value at load is the NUMBER 1 and this button's Value the number 1: the group converts it to "1", so not selected — a strict compare
selected, then a sibling picked: the click took the selection from this button — Checked false and Changed; another sibling picked: nothing on this button

a sibling carrying THIS button's Value picked: both are selected — Checked true and no Changed (the person clicked the other); the other sibling picked: this one loses the selection to that click — Checked false and Changed
the graph writes the group's Value to this button's Value: Checked true at the frame's end, no Changed; to another: Checked false, no Changed

selected, a click raises the pointer events alone; then the graph writes the group's Value away (an advance) and a click in the same frame: the click's paint shows the write first, so it meets an unselected button and selects it again — Changed (Checked ends true, as it began). v1's name said this click raised the pointer events alone

a click, then this button's Value written away in the same frame: Changed for the click, then the button shows that the group no longer names it — Checked ends false, with no second Changed; its Value written back: Checked true, no Changed
this button's Value written to the group's: selected at the next paint — Checked true, no Changed; written away: Checked false, no Changed

Mounted off: Will Unmount, Checked keeps its value, a click finds nothing, a sibling picked still moves the selection; Mounted on: Did Mount, and the button shows the group's choice — Checked false, no Changed (nobody clicked it while it was on the page)
focused, then a sibling picked: the mouse button down on the sibling takes the keyboard — Blurred — and the pick deselects this one (Changed)
a sibling picked in no group: there is no sibling — nothing

disabled: a click takes nothing, but a sibling carrying this button's Value picked selects it too — Checked true, no Changed (a disabled radio still shows the group's selection; only a click on it fires)
a click, then a sibling pick, then a click in one frame: each moves the selection — Checked true, false, true: sent as true, Changed three times
a disabled button takes no click, press, release or focus — the pointer still hovers it, and a finger reports nothing (C64)
the Focus action puts the keyboard on the input (Focused, Done); again: Done alone; Blur: Blurred, Done; again: Done alone
Enabled off and a Focus in the same frame: the button is still enabled on the page, so it takes the keyboard; in the next frame a Focus is Done and takes nothing
focused, then disabled: Focused stays true — a disabled element gives the keyboard up to nobody, so a Blur is Done and nothing fires; re-enabled, Blur takes it
Enabled follows its input as a boolean and is sent only on a change
Scroll Into View and every look or layout input change nothing on the wire

a person acts on a painted page: Mounted written off and an act in the same frame find no element (a Focus after it is Unchanged); written on, the act meets the element (a Focus after it is Done) — every act, both ways

scenarios.name: placed disabled, Mounted off then on with a press in the same frame: Did Mount and nothing else (a disabled element takes no press); a Focus after it Done and nothing focused; the same with a release

focused, then Enable Label turned on: the input and its keyboard stay — a press fires Pointer Down with no Focused; turned off again while focused: the same — a Tab onto it finds the keyboard there already

focused, then Enable Label changed and a Tab away in the same frame: the keyboard is still on the button, so the Tab takes it — Blurred; a Blur action after it is Done alone; changed back with another Tab away: nothing to take
pressed and focused, then Enable Label changed and the release in the same frame: Pointer Up, and the keyboard is still there — a Blur action after it fires Blurred; a Tab onto it then fires Focused
Mounted off then on, and a Tab onto the button in the same frame: Did Mount and Focused together; the same with Enabled off: Did Mount alone, a Focus after it Done
a press held across a frame, then the release and a Blur action in the same frame: Pointer Up, then Blurred — the keyboard the press gave is still there to take away
focused, then disabled; Enable Label changed and a release in the same frame: nothing (a disabled input takes no release) and the keyboard stays; re-enabled, a Blur action gives it up (Blurred)
focused, then Enable Label changed and the pointer moving onto the button in the same frame: Hover Start, and the keyboard is still there — a Blur action after it fires Blurred
focused, then the pointer onto the button and a Blur action in the same frame: Hover Start, then Blurred — a hover alone moves no keyboard
a sibling picked while this button is not selected: nothing on this button — but the selection moved: this button's Value written to it later is selected (nobody clicked it: no Changed)
placed off the page in a group whose Value at load names it: nothing; Mounted on: Did Mount, Checked true, no Changed

a sibling carrying this button's Value picked and the group's Value written back in the same frame: the button shows what the Value says — unselected, nothing on the wire; the other sibling picked: nothing (the group names it already); a click selects this one: Checked true, Changed
a pick and the group's Value written back in one frame, then this button's Value written to the picked one: the group names the other, so nothing moves
a write the group ignores (null) or already holds between two it takes: nothing moves
a write the group ignores while it holds nothing: this button (Value 'a') stays unselected — a write it takes, beside it, selects it
a write the group ignores while it holds nothing: this button (Value 'b') stays unselected — a write it takes, beside it, selects it
focused, then Enable Label changed and the pointer leaving in the same frame: Hover End, and the keyboard is still there — a Blur action after it fires Blurred

focused, then Enable Label changed and a pick of the sibling already selected in the same frame: the mouse press on the sibling takes the keyboard — Blurred — and nothing else (a selected radio raises no change); a Blur action after it is Done alone
focused, a sibling picked: Blurred, and the group takes its Value — this button's Value written to it later is selected (nobody clicked it: no Changed)
focused, the sibling already selected picked: Blurred and nothing else — the group keeps its Value, so this button's Value written to the OTHER sibling's stays unselected
a remount after a pick written back in its frame: Mounted off, this button's Value written to the picked one, Mounted on — Did Mount and nothing else: the group names the other
focused, then Enable Label changed and a touch in the same frame: Pointer Down, and the keyboard is still there — a Blur action after it fires Blurred
focused, then Enable Label changed and a lift in the same frame: Pointer Up, and the keyboard is still there — a Blur action after it fires Blurred
Enable Label turned off, then the Focus action: the button is on the page and takes the keyboard (Focused, Done)
a Label that is an object with Enable Label on: the label is drawn as its text and the page keeps drawing
Margin Top wired null: the style is removed, as for undefined — nothing moves on the wire and the node keeps working
Pos X wired undefined: back to 0 — nothing moves on the wire and the node keeps working
Visible off: a hidden button is under no pointer and takes no keyboard — every act raises nothing; the Focus action is Done with nothing; shown again, a click is a click
Visible off in the frame of an act: the act's paint hides the button first — the act raises nothing; one that held the keyboard keeps it (no focus fixup), and a blur takes it off

Visible off: a hidden button cannot be clicked, but a sibling picked in its group still is — the pick is the sibling's click: this hidden button carries the same Value, so it is Checked too, with no Changed
hidden, holding the keyboard: every pointer act meets nothing and takes nothing away — the Blur action after each finds the keyboard on the button (Blurred)
hidden, holding the keyboard, Enable Label changed with every pointer act: the act meets nothing and the keyboard stays — the Blur action after each finds it on the button (Blurred)

Enabled off, a pick of the sibling already selected and a Focus action in one frame: the pick's paint disables the input first, so the Focus is Done and takes nothing; Visible off the same way: Done, nothing

a button carrying 'a' in a group on 'b': the sibling already selected ('b') picked — nothing on this button and the group keeps its Value; a click on this button then selects it: Pointer Down, Focused, Pointer Up, Checked true and Changed
Mounted off, a pick of the sibling already selected and a Focus action in one frame: the pick's paint takes the button off the page first (Will Unmount), so the Focus is Unchanged
